title: Graduate Premium Engagement, Reputation and Survey Performance

decisionLog.outcome: Reconstructed 2.4.4 around three connected work packages: student proposition and adoption; external reputation and market activation; and strategic survey performance and reputation optimisation. Year 1 will prove the operating model, prioritising internal proposition work and targeted Graduate Outcomes response-rate optimisation while 2.4.1 builds the graduate premium evidence and content estate. Year 2 scales student adoption and tests targeted external activation; Year 3 embeds the strongest approaches and builds sustained reputation and survey-performance capability. Headline resourcing assumes 0.5 FTE dedicated activation/reputation delivery capacity in 2026/27, rising to 1.0 FTE in 2027/28 and 2028/29, alongside existing shared King's Edge analytics, project-officer and programme-management capacity and an indicative flexible activation/research envelope of £25,000, £50,000 and £75,000. The precise role design, analytical requirement and business-as-usual destination remain to be validated during proposition review.

Added a programme-controlled Strategic Partnerships, Profile & External Engagement Fund to 2.4.4 as the single accounting home for flexible external-engagement investment deployable across King's Edge. The fund is £25,000 in 2026/27, £35,000 in 2027/28 and £45,000 in 2028/29, with a £45,000 annual recurrent BAU planning liability from 2029/30. It is additional to the existing activation, research and survey-intervention envelopes and must not be double counted against 2.2.2 partnership infrastructure or other package budgets.
